snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2: Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description: Enjoy this fresh look at gameplay from PowerWash Simulator 2, the follow-up to the hit zen-like powerwashing game that now adds things like multi-stage jobs, home base customization, a cat companion you can pet and take on every job, and more. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2968420/PowerWash_Simulator_2/
